competitorInsights: Direct competitors win on clarity, controls, or scale, not on parser elegance alone.
High-config tools attract complaints about complexity, nonsense conversions, and browser overhead.
The larger players drift toward broader shopper economics or platform ecosystems, not pure conversion utility.
